2301-4279-6794--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2301-4279-6794--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn, Abzan Ascendancy and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Abzan Ascendancy ability, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

513-1778-2459.easyPrerequisites: One of the creatures with mana cost {0} must be in your hand with the other being on the battlefield.
513-1778-2459.description:
Cast the creature with mana cost {0} from your hand by paying {0}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the other creature with mana cost {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Repeat.

2724-4428-8172.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Wormfang Manta entering does not cause its abillity to trigger due to Karn.
Repeat each turn.

147-5256-8129.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-5256-8129.notablePrerequisites: There are at least seven cards in your graveyard.
147-5256-8129.description:
Cast Stitch Together by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Stitch Together.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, causing a player to mill card(s).
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Stitch Together
Resolve the Stitch Together copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

640-1981-2415-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Dross Harvester and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat.

1987-6747-7487.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-6747-7487.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
1987-6747-7487.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Zealous Lorecaster.
When Zealous Lorecaster enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-6747-7487.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

4002-4331-4993-7693.easyPrerequisites:
You control three or more lands that share a name.
Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
4002-4331-4993-7693.description:
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

893-1558-4840-7654.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five untapped Myr.
893-1558-4840-7654.description:
Activate Myr Turbine by tapping it and five Myr, searching your library for Myr Battlesphere and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Myr Battlesphere enters, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing Myr Battlesphere and the four Myr tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Sundering Archaic by paying {2}, putting Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Repeat each turn.

423-433-1437-1671--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-433-1437-1671--85.description:
Cast Llanowar Scout by paying {1}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Llanowar Scout spell three times.
Resolve the first Llanowar Scout copy.
Activate the Llanowar Scout token by tapping it, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

3532-5078-5705-6608.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Jace's Projection triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1497-4446-5220-6900.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Cleric.
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
1497-4446-5220-6900.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

4559-5686-6753.notablePrerequisites: The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is at least 11.
4559-5686-6753.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, creating two Blood tokens.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Bloods, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2292-4484-4871-5643-6747.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
2292-4484-4871-5643-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
2292-4484-4871-5643-6747.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Viscera Seer abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2292-4484-4871-5643-6747.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-1753-2043-6311.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Urza's ability, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Resolve both Urza abilities, creating two token copies of Radiant Lotus that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creatures.
Activate a Radiant Lotus token by tapping it and sacrificing both Radiant Lotus tokens, targeting yourself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying the Radiant Lotus token's ability, targeting yourself.
Resolve both Radiant Lotus abilities, adding twelve mana of any color.
Repeat.

1913-2073-2981--90.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the artifact with mana value 1 or less.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Imotekh's first ability triggers, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
When the Necron Warriors enter the battlefield, Salvaging Station triggers twice, untapping Salvaging Station.
Repeat.

3139-5686--5.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the persist creature.
The sacrificed creature's persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
The Great Henge triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to draw a card.
The -1/-1 and +1/+1 counters are removed as a state-based action.
Resolve the ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2292-6243-6288.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Infernal Vessel.
When Infernal Vessel dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Demon in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Infernal Vessel.
When Infernal Vessel dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Infernal Vessel from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel in additional to its other types.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

851-1270-2457-5794.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating six 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping four Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

719-2034-5853.manaNeeded: {3}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
719-2034-5853.notablePrerequisites: Xenograft on the battlefield with "Rat" chosen.
719-2034-5853.description:
Cast Wick either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Wick enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, if you control a Snail, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Snail, adding {C}{C}.
If needed, repeat step 3 until you do not control a Snail.
Resolve the Wick trigger, creating a 1/1 Snail creature token.
When the Snail enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Xenograft, Wick triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

1636-5251-5268.notablePrerequisites:
Utopia Vow attached to Emmara.
Emmara does not have summoning sickness.
1636-5251-5268.description:
Activate Emmara by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Warrior creature token.
The Human Warrior enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

uses.n: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness

2178-4050-4147-4294.manaNeeded: {5}{R}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2178-4050-4147-4294.notablePrerequisites:
It is your precombat main phase.
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Hua Tuo.
2178-4050-4147-4294.description:
Cast Etali from your hand or from the command zone by paying {5}{R}{R} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Etali enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Etali, adding one mana of any color.
If Etali is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Etali dies, Hua Tuo triggers, untapping Hua Tuo.
Activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting Etali on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Etali trigger from step 2, causing you to exile cards from each player's library until you exile a nonland card, with you exiling Etali from your library, and cast Etali and any other nonland cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs.
Repeat from step 2.

1020-2866-4659-5111.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken artifact with mana value one or less that can be cast using only colorless mana.
1020-2866-4659-5111.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the nontoken artifact with mana value one or less and Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, its ability triggers twice, returning Scrap Trawler and the nontoken artifact with mana one or less to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Scrap Trawler and the nontoken artifact by paying at most {4}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the nontoken artifact and Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Scrap Trawler triggers twice for itself dying, and once for the nontoken artifact.
Resolve the Scrap Trawler trigger for the nontoken artifact, returning any applicable artifact to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the remaining Scrap Trawler triggers, returning the nontoken artifact and Myr Retriever to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast the nontoken artifact and Myr Retriever by paying at most {3}.
Repeat.

553-3093.notablePrerequisites: NOTE: This combo fails if two of the top six cards of your library share a name.
553-3093.description:
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to gain seven life and put Approach of the Second Sun into your library seventh from the top.
Cast Tainted Pact by paying {1}{B}, exiling cards from the top of your library until you exile Approach of the Second Sun, putting it into your hand.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to win the game.

3851-3951.notablePrerequisites:
Blade of Selves attached to Éomer.
Éomer cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
You have at least three opponents.
3851-3951.description:
Declare Éomer as an attacker.
Éomer's myriad ability triggers, creating at least two token copies of it tapped and attacking each other opponent.
Put all Éomer tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Éomer token(s) die, each Éomer token triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2200-3542-5003.notablePrerequisites: You control up to six lands that can tap to produce at least {5}.
2200-3542-5003.description:
Activate Diamond Valley by tapping it and sacrificing Palinchron, gaining life equal to Palinchron's toughness.
Nim Deathmantle triggers, costing you {4} to return Palinchron to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to Palinchron.
Palinchron enters the battlefield, untapping Diamond Valley and up to six lands you control that can produce at least {5}.
Activate up to six lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}.
Repeat.

645-914-2034-3750.notablePrerequisites:
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
645-914-2034-3750.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {C}{C}.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase.
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, holding priority, activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W/B}{W/B}.
Resolve the Alesha trigger, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 3.
